summary: Iteration 121: Bug Fixes Testing - All 3 reported bugs VERIFIED FIXED. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Cadastro page stays on /cadastro, Feed page loads with post creation area and stories section.

issues: 429 rate limit errors in console during rapid testing - EXPECTED behavior with security hardening (100 req/min limit)

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ BUG 1 FIXED: Feed allows posting - post creation textarea and Publicar button visible and functional
✅ BUG 1 FIXED: Feed stories section visible - 'Seu Story' with + button, shows 'Nenhum story ativo'
✅ BUG 2 FIXED: /api/assessorias/lista is now public (returns 200 without token)
✅ BUG 3 FIXED: Cadastro page stays on /cadastro (no redirect to /login)
✅ Cadastro page shows all form fields: Nome, Email, Senha, Equipe/Assessoria dropdown
✅ Equipe dropdown loads assessorias list from GET /api/assessorias/lista
✅ Anti-bot scope correctly reduced to only: /ranking, /liga-assessorias, /strava-atividades, /badges/ranking
✅ Axios interceptor correctly skips redirect on /login and /cadastro paths
✅ Protected endpoints still return 401 without token: /api/ranking/povao, /api/liga-assessorias/ranking, /api/feed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 121 verified 3 bug fixes: (1) Feed posting/stories now work - anti-bot no longer monitors /feed/, (2) /api/assessorias/lista is public again for cadastro dropdown, (3) Cadastro page stays open - Axios interceptor skips redirect on /cadastro path. All security features from iteration 120 still working (protected endpoints return 401, rate limiting active).
